newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish board lifts suspension on brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Turkish board lifts suspension on brokerage.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) lifted a two-month-long suspension on activities of brokerage house Ozhan Oral Menkul Degerler A.S. on Friday, it said in a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
The board said the decision was taken to conform with a court ruling which halted the SPK's suspension.

The activities of the brokerage were stopped by the SPK on December 19 after it failed to deliver securities as collateral against its cash and share liabilities to customers working with one of its agencies.
The board had asked the company to fulfill its obligation to deposit a certain amount of government securities at the central depository Takasbank.
